description: Year 0000 is syntactically date-shaped (matches the ISO date grammar) but fails calendar-component validation — Core's valid range is 0001-9999 (Appendix A). Distinct from core.dates.utc-range.* (§6.5.3), which tests a valid literal year pushed out of range by UTC offset adjustment; this tests the literal year field itself, with no offset involved. Falls back to a string in non-strict mode.
